mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the negative economic signal.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year, the real interest rate becomes negative, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors seek higher returns in equities.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) remains below 4%, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month and UNRATE < 4%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals increased demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeds 3% year-over-year and industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 2% year-over-year, it signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY > 3% and INDPRO YoY > 2%.
